slides.texte_overlay:
How to become ridiculously
easy to like
Be glad to see people. A real smile, their name, "Good to see you." It sounds simple, but people can feel when you're actually happy they showed up, and they love you for it.
Talk about them more than about you. Ask, listen, ask again. People walk away from a chat where they did most of the talking thinking you're one of the best people they've met.
Laugh easily, including at yourself. Spilled drink, wrong name, bad joke. Laugh it off. Easygoing people make everyone around them relax, and relaxed people like whoever caused it.
Share what you learn. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and I always have a fun fact for whoever I'm with. People like the guy who makes their day a bit more interesting.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. I always have a fun fact for whoever I'm with, and people like the guy who makes their day interesting.

slides.texte_overlay: Say nice things about people behind their back. "Tom is honestly the most reliable guy I know." It always gets back to them, and everyone trusts the guy who never talks badly about others.
Offer help before you're asked. Carry a bag, hold a door, lend a charger. Small, quick, no big deal. Kindness that doesn't wait to be asked is one of the most likeable things there is.
Don't complain. Not about the weather, the queue, the traffic. Light, positive energy is magnetic, and the guy who stays upbeat is the one everyone wants around.
